synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed \u2014 a self-funding margin inflection collides with a sharp revenue reversal and extreme, low-visibility leverage.

bull_points.claim: Absolute EBITDA inflected positive and grew over the multi-year run (Dec-2021 -180 to Dec-2025 74, LTM 52), and gross margin climbed steadily from -28% to 35%, so the falling EBITDA margin % is partly the optical read while the absolute trajectory turned positive.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bull_points.claim: The company is FCF-positive at $39.6M LTM, meaning it is self-funding with no runway constraint despite the unknown solvency leg.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Cash Flow 'Levered Free Cash Flow' [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: Interest coverage of 10.6x LTM indicates EBITDA comfortably services interest expense.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement EBITDA ÷ Interest Expense [LTM 12 months Mar-31-2026]

bull_points.claim: On a forward basis the name's NTM TEV/EBITDA of 17.19 sits between peer low 7.63 and the heterogeneous peer mean 43.3 — posing whether any discount is RESIDUAL (overshoot) rather than purely EARNED, a question the human must judge against the fundamental_deltas, not a clean benchmark given the 8063x cap dispersion.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

bear_points.claim: Revenue rolled over (-25.5% YoY latest same-quarter; LTM 372 vs FY2025 428) and ROIC fell back to 1.5% LTM from 3.3% — the inflection is reversing, not consolidating, so the margin recovery story is losing top-line support.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement + Segments + Ratios (multi-year columns)

bear_points.claim: The EBITDA margin % itself fell from 17% (Dec-2025) to 14% (LTM) AND absolute EBITDA fell from 74 to 52 — here the % decline is the REAL signal, not an optical artifact, because the absolute reconciler moved the same direction.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Financials→Income Statement (margin % + absolute EBITDA reconciler)

bear_points.claim: Leverage is extreme on the comp read: Debt/EBITDA 24.2 vs peer-median 1.8, alongside worse rev growth (-9% vs 2%) and EBITDA growth (-66% vs 2%) — inputs pointing to an EARNED discount (value trap) rather than residual overshoot, for the human to judge.
bear_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Operating Statistics (name vs peer median: growth/margin/leverage/beta)

bear_points.claim: 100% of revenue is a single Battery Systems segment with no geographic anchor (China 33%, Italy 22%, France 18%, U.S. only 9%), concentrating the business in one product line exposed to subsidy phaseouts and tariff frameworks management flagged.

Two discrete earnings-driven gap-downs (2026-03-17 and 2026-05-12, both 8-K item 2.02) plus a third unmatched on 2026-05-18 show the de-rating clustered on results, not a market-wide move, with the name -80% relative to IWM over 180 days.

bear_points.claim: Share count is diluting (+2.9% over ~1.7y to 333.2M) with a stack of convertible bonds and shareholder convertible loans in the capital structure, adding ongoing equity dilution pressure.
